Class PointOfRoute

java.lang.Object
domain.PointOfRoute
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PointOfRoute extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a point in a train route, containing information about the station and cargo operations. Implements Serializable to support object persistence.
